versions.content: The following configuration constraints are conditionally recommended for FlexRay NM:  NM_REPEAT_MESSAGE_TIME = 0 (conditions: (1) startup of all applications is completed as soon as the FlexRay communication is started and (2) node detection is not required in the FlexRay NM-cluster)  FrNmReadySleepCnt = 0 (condition: bus communication is always shut down at the end of the NM Repetition Cycle in all nodes within the same FlexRay NM- cluster, even in presence of race conditions)
